strips.title: A day with the Beckham pillows — in real life

panels.head: Saturday, 9 a.m.
panels.text: Two flat vacuum-packed rolls arrive. Vera shakes them out and gives them a day to puff up.

panels.head: Plush, with a core
panels.text: On the bed they look full and soft. Back and light side sleepers get on well with them.

panels.head: The catch
panels.text: Months later one pillow sits lower. Vera does the fold test: if it stays folded, it is done.

panels.head: Afterwards
panels.text: A gentle wash, dryer balls, a fluff, and a spare pair for the guest room.
